name: Fracture & Fracture Mechanics
summary: Explains how cracks cause failure, from Griffith's energy balance to fracture toughness testing and toughening mechanisms.

topics.name: Ductile versus brittle fracture; fractography basics
Theoretical cohesive strength and stress concentration at flaws (Inglis)
Griffith energy balance and strain energy release rate G
Linear elastic fracture mechanics: stress intensity factor K and fracture modes I, II, III
Fracture toughness K_IC and plane-strain testing (ASTM E399)
Crack-tip plasticity: Irwin plastic zone and small-scale yielding
Elastic-plastic fracture mechanics: CTOD and the J-integral
Ductile fracture mechanisms: void nucleation, growth and coalescence
Cleavage, intergranular fracture and the ductile-to-brittle transition (Charpy impact testing)
R-curves and toughening mechanisms in metals, ceramics and composites
Statistics of brittle fracture: Weibull analysis
Environment-assisted cracking: stress-corrosion cracking and hydrogen embrittlement
